title: Jungle theme, theme switcher and critter cast
summary: Adds the Jungle theme beside Glassy (today's Soft glass look, still the default), a theme switcher with Calm mode, and the Spike-plus-six critter cast in both themes.
changes: Theme registry lists Glassy and Jungle, each with light and dark tokens; Glassy keeps the Soft glass look unchanged.
People choose Glassy or Jungle, Light or Dark, and Calm mode from the user menu, Profile Appearance, or the guest footer picker.
Signed-in choices are stored on the account; guests keep them in the browser; Admin can set the default skin for people who have not chosen.
Pages open in the chosen theme without a flash; Calm mode turns off decorations and motion while keeping empty-state critters.
Spike plus six new critters (Cleo, Dot, Speck, Moss, Noodle, Rio) appear in empty states, errors, tips, menus and footers in both themes.
Jungle-only canopy, leaf and vine decorations; emails stay on fixed Glassy branding; public pages follow the visitor's theme.
Contrast checks, decorative asset budget and CI Playwright visual snapshots guard the look.
affected_areas: User menu, profile Appearance and guest footer
Mascot tips, empty states and error pages
Help, brand guide and art register
version_rationale: MINOR: new Jungle theme and switcher alongside Glassy; nothing removed.
validation: PHPUnit theme registry, contrast, preference, switcher, decor, cast, budget and email/public theme tests.
CI Playwright theme snapshot job (40 snapshots) and ThemeSnapshotManifestTest.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for Glassy and Jungle with the switcher.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.75.0 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Embeddable form theme per form stays in a later milestone (#1007 / v0.84.0).
Account Appearance page beyond /profile lands with v0.77.0; switcher is already in the user menu and on Profile.
Cast WebP fallbacks are optional; SVG is the primary format.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.74.0). Theme preference columns on users are additive and safe to leave in place.
provenance: Milestone v0.75.0 Beta: Jungle theme, theme switcher and critter cast, Epic #863, pull request #1043.
